description.value: The Hospitality Inn is a motel-style property perched on a hillside above Kamloops, offering panoramic views of the city, rivers, and surrounding valley from its open terraced lawns. Centrally located within easy walking distance of downtown, Thompson Rivers University, and the Tournament Capital Centre, it serves families, sport teams, conference groups, and golfers. Guests have access to a seasonal heated outdoor pool, whirlpool, barbeque area, and rooms with full or mini kitchens — a practical, affordable base in a cycling-rich region.

address.value: 500 Columbia Street West, Kamloops, BC V2C 1K6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides a detailed amenities page. Coin-up laundry on site and free wireless access are explicitly listed on the amenities page. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, drying area, e-bike charging, or any other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site. The contact page (250-374-4164, 500 West Columbia Street) matches the OSM tags, confirming the listing is current and the business is open (2025 copyright shown).
concerns: Minor address word-order discrepancy: OSM has '500 Columbia Street West', website has '500 West Columbia Street' — same physical address, different formatting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel in central Kamloops with a live website, confirmed contact details, and on-site laundry and Wi-Fi useful to touring cyclists.

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states easy walking distance to 'restaurants and pubs' in downtown Kamloops
